The main takeaway from our work is that

the NCI- 60 cell methylome database provides an invaluable resource for systems pharmacologic studies, including the identification of novel drug targets, drug repurposing, and the integration of DNA methylation with transcript levels and other molecular data.

DNA methylation is an important regulator of gene expression, and it is a key player in the regulation of the expression of the genes that we have shown are important for drug response in cancer cells.
